inlineSchema:
generator client {
  provider        = "prisma-client-js"
  previewFeatures = ["postgresqlExtensions"]
  engineType      = "library"
}

datasource db {
  provider   = "postgresql"
  extensions = [postgis, uuid_ossp(map: "uuid-ossp")]
}

model Role {
  id        String   @id @default(dbgenerated("uuid_generate_v4()")) @db.Uuid
  name      String   @unique
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  users     User[]
}

model User {
  id            String              @id @default(dbgenerated("uuid_generate_v4()")) @db.Uuid
  email         String              @unique
  password      String
  firstName     String?
  lastName      String?
  roleId        String              @db.Uuid
  deletedAt     DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime            @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime            @updatedAt
  statusChanges TripStatusHistory[]
  role          Role                @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id])

  @@index([email])
}

model Vessel {
  id        String     @id @default(dbgenerated("uuid_generate_v4()")) @db.Uuid
  name      String
  imo       String     @unique
  mmsi      String     @unique
  type      VesselType @default(OTHER)
  flag      String?
  deletedAt DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime   @updatedAt
  alerts    Alert[]
  trips     Trip[]

  @@index([mmsi])
  @@index([imo])
}

model Trip {
  id        String              @id @default(dbgenerated("uuid_generate_v4()")) @db.Uuid
  vesselId  String              @db.Uuid
  status    TripStatus          @default(PLANNED)
  startTime DateTime?
  endTime   DateTime?
  deletedAt DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime            @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime            @updatedAt
  alerts    Alert[]
  points    LocationPoint[]
  vessel    Vessel              @relation(fields: [vesselId], references: [id])
  history   TripStatusHistory[]

  @@index([vesselId])
  @@index([status])
}

model LocationPoint {
  id        String                   @id @default(dbgenerated("uuid_generate_v4()")) @db.Uuid
  tripId    String                   @db.Uuid
  latitude  Float
  longitude Float
  speed     Float?
  heading   Float?
  timestamp DateTime                 @default(now())
  geom      Unsupported("geometry")?
  trip      Trip                     @relation(fields: [tripId], references: [id])

  @@index([tripId])
  @@index([timestamp])
}

model Zone {
  id        String                  @id @default(dbgenerated("uuid_generate_v4()")) @db.Uuid
  name      String
  type      String
  geom      Unsupported("geometry")
  createdAt DateTime                @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime                @updatedAt
  alerts    Alert[]
}

model Alert {
  id         String        @id @default(dbgenerated("uuid_generate_v4()")) @db.Uuid
  vesselId   String        @db.Uuid
  tripId     String?       @db.Uuid
  zoneId     String?       @db.Uuid
  type       String
  severity   AlertSeverity @default(MEDIUM)
  status     AlertStatus   @default(ACTIVE)
  message    String
  timestamp  DateTime      @default(now())
  resolvedAt DateTime?
  trip       Trip?         @relation(fields: [tripId], references: [id])
  vessel     Vessel        @relation(fields: [vesselId], references: [id])
  zone       Zone?         @relation(fields: [zoneId], references: [id])

  @@index([vesselId])
  @@index([tripId])
  @@index([severity])
}

model TripStatusHistory {
  id        String     @id @default(dbgenerated("uuid_generate_v4()")) @db.Uuid
  tripId    String     @db.Uuid
  status    TripStatus
  changedBy String?    @db.Uuid
  timestamp DateTime   @default(now())
  remarks   String?
  user      User?      @relation(fields: [changedBy], references: [id])
  trip      Trip       @relation(fields: [tripId], references: [id])

  @@index([tripId])
}

/// This table contains check constraints and requires additional setup for migrations. Visit https://pris.ly/d/check-constraints for more info.
model spatial_ref_sys {
  srid      Int     @id
  auth_name String? @db.VarChar(256)
  auth_srid Int?
  srtext    String? @db.VarChar(2048)
  proj4text String? @db.VarChar(2048)
}

enum VesselType {
  CARGO
  TANKER
  PASSENGER
  FISHING
  TUG
  RECREATIONAL
  OTHER
}

enum TripStatus {
  PLANNED
  ACTIVE
  COMPLETED
  CANCELLED
}

enum AlertSeverity {
  INFO
  LOW
  MEDIUM
  HIGH
  CRITICAL
}

enum AlertStatus {
  ACTIVE
  RESOLVED
  ACKNOWLEDGED
}
